comparison.scope: Exploratory comparison of already-observed history, not unseen evidence. Fixed rules; no selection or tuning. Independent $10,000 fractional long/cash portfolios per stage. Prior-bar signals, next-open fills, final-close liquidation. Price returns only; no dividends, taxes, cash interest, market impact, shorts, options, FX, crypto, intraday or news strategy modeling.

strategies.rule: Long when prior 20-close mean exceeds prior 50-close mean; otherwise cash.
Enter when prior close exceeds the preceding 20 closes (excluding signal close); exit below their minimum; otherwise retain position.
Enter when prior close is at least 2% below prior 20-close mean; exit when prior close reaches that mean; otherwise retain position.
